thesis: Annaly Capital Management Inc. memiliki fundamental cukup (skor 58/100) dengan keunggulan utama di valuasi (78) dan pertumbuhan (66). Titik lemahnya ada di kesehatan keuangan (12). Gabungan model DCF, multiple sektor, dan target analis menghasilkan nilai wajar $27.62 — potensi naik 57.0% dalam ~12 bulan (keyakinan rendah). Kondisi teknikal sangat lemah (20/100). Risiko geopolitik rendah.

cons.text: Lonjakan laba sangat besar (+116%) — bila bisnisnya siklikal, P/E rendah di puncak siklus bisa menyesatkan; proyeksi berisiko terlalu optimistis.
Harga di bawah MA200 ($20.48) — tren jangka panjang masih lemah.
Payout ratio 201% — dividen melebihi laba, keberlanjutan perlu dicermati.
P/E 12.2x — 60% di atas median P/E-nya sendiri (7.7x); valuasi sudah mahal dibanding biasanya.

pros.text: P/E forward 5.7x — 84% lebih murah dari median sektor Properti (34.4x).
Free cash flow yield 19.2%: setiap $100 nilai saham menghasilkan $19.2 kas bebas per tahun ($2.7 M).
Laba per saham (EPS) diproyeksikan naik 116% — dari $1.44 ke $3.11.
Margin operasi 80% — tanda pricing power dan keunggulan kompetitif (moat).
PEG ratio 0.09 — pertumbuhan laba belum sepenuhnya tercermin di harga (GARP: Growth at Reasonable Price).
Estimasi nilai wajar $27.62 vs harga $17.59 — potensi naik 57% (rentang $20–$33).

summary: Annaly Capital Management, Inc., a diversified capital manager, engages in the residential mortgage finance business. The company invests in agency mortgage-backed securities collateralized by residential mortgages; non-agency residential whole loans and securitized products within the residential and commercial markets; mortgage servicing rights; agency commercial mortgage-backed securities; to-be-announced forward contracts; residential mortgage-backed securities; residential mortgage loans; and agency or private label credit risk transfer securities.
